mainEntity.name: How fast can Good Life Lending fund a loan?

acceptedAnswer.text: We can go from approval to funding in as little as 5 days. Traditional banks average 25–40+ days. If speed is part of your deal, that difference matters.

mainEntity.name: What do I need to qualify for a hard money loan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Good Life Lending requires decent credit, real cash in the deal, and a solid opportunity. We evaluate the person and the deal together, not just a score on a page.

mainEntity.name: What types of loans does Good Life Lending offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: We specialize in fix-and-flip loans, bridge loans for investors, and private money lending for real estate investment properties.

mainEntity.name: Does Good Life Lending work with first-time investors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We work with investors on their first or second flip as well as experienced investors looking to scale. What matters is the deal quality, your credit, and your cash position.

mainEntity.name: Is Good Life Lending a lender of last resort?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. We're selective because we want our borrowers to succeed. We fund the right people with the right deals, not everyone who applies.
